contexts.text: It is predicated of them that they are blackened, and that they have no light () when there is no longer any wisdom of good or intelligence of truth.
Affirmatives of falsity are there represented by dusky and black clouds.
They are said to be blackened () when goods and truths are no longer acknowledged.
That then the Knowledges of good and truth perish, is signified by, I will blacken the stars of the heavens, and all the luminaries of light ().
They are said to be blackened () when they no longer appear.
They are said to be blackened, etc. when they no longer exist.
Some (devils) appear as black as soot.

The heavens where there is no light, and which will be blackened () = the interiors of the men of the Church, which, when closed through evils and falsities, do not admit light from Heaven, but instead thereof darkness from Hell.
That there will then be no Knowledges of truth, is signified by, I will blacken the stars thereof (). AE 401:13.
The heavens are said to be blackened () when there does not flow in from the Lord through Heaven any affection and perception of truth.

As mourning in the representative Churches... represented spiritual pain of mind on account of there being no good and truth... they went blackened, as in David. Why go I blackened in the oppression of the enemy? (; ). Further Illustrated.
The sun and the moon being blackened () = that there are no good of love and truth of faith.
That the goods and truths of the Church... will be turned into evils and falsities, is signified by the sun and moon being darkened and blackened...
